facts.what: 揭穿真名：George Finlay Munro，Finlay 只是中间名
facts.anchor: ‘His name is George, Nova. Not fucking Finlay – that’s his middle name.

facts.what: 联想到日记作者＝他的前女友＝眼前 Blair
facts.anchor: It’s her. The ex. The author of the book digging into my spine.

facts.what: 质问 Cassie 是否告诉 George 她死了；George 清楚她没死
facts.anchor: ‘You told him I was dead? What the fuck, Nova? George knows fine well I’m not dead.’

facts.what: 日记内容对上：同居、圣诞约会、发色被染深
facts.anchor: The stories of moving in together, Christmas dates, and a huge arrow pointing at the colour of her hair darker than an eclipsed sky.

facts.what: 忏悔自己未经许可把「她」写死，像处理剧里碍事角色
facts.anchor: I killed her off without permission.

facts.what: 命令她立刻走；Cassie 坚持要带猫 Luna
facts.anchor: ‘But I can’t leave without Luna, my cat.

facts.what: 正把 Luna 塞进航空箱，门口又响锁孔，两人同时回头
facts.anchor: I hear the click of the door once more

relations: Blair 与 Cassie 结盟逃亡；Cassie 仍在给 Finlay/George 当解读师
